instruction.sound: Ergänze den Text mit everybody, somebody, nobody oder anybody.

atoms.b: Today we had a maths test. Before the test, ((everybody)) was talking loudly. During the test, ((nobody)) was speaking anymore. It was so quiet, you could hardly hear ((anybody)) move. Suddenly, ((somebody)) sneezed, and I jumped a little. After the test, ((everybody)) looked tired. But soon, there was laughter everywhere again.

instruction.sound: Ergänze den Text mit someone, somebody, something oder somewhere.

atoms.b: On Saturday, Mia went to the park with her parents. She saw ((++someone somewhere)) on the swings. There was ((++somebody nobody)) on the slide too. She started to walk around. She found ((++something someone)) shiny on the ground. It was a button. She walked towards the trees, and saw a squirrel ((++somewhere somebody)) in the distance. She felt happy exploring.
